How to Measure Your Head

Measure around the widest part of your head, starting from the front of your forehead and passing above your ears and around the back of your head. Keep the measuring tape level and snug, but not too tight. The measurement in centimeters (cm) is your head circumference—use it to choose the right helmet size.

The extra-wide 20 × 4.0-inch fat tyres provide a broad contact area for improved grip and stability on gravel, sand, grass and uneven paths. Whether you're commuting through town or exploring outdoor trails, the fat tyre design helps deliver a more confident riding experience.

Up to 100 km Range on a Single Charge

Powered by a 36V 10.4Ah battery with 378Wh capacity, the EB5 offers up to 100 km of range under ideal test conditions. Actual range varies depending on rider weight, terrain, temperature, riding mode and other factors. A 4–5 hour charging time makes it convenient to recharge between rides.

Front and Rear Suspension for Added Comfort

The front suspension and shock-absorbing seat system help reduce vibrations from bumps and uneven surfaces. Combined with the wide tyres and comfortable saddle, the EB5 is designed to make daily commutes and longer leisure rides more comfortable.

Reliable Braking and Clear LCD Display

Dual disc brakes with motor cut-off provide responsive braking control. The LCD display shows essential riding information, including speed and battery level, while integrated front and rear lights help improve visibility. With IPX4 water resistance, the EB5 is also designed to handle light splashes during everyday use.

Built for Everyday Practicality

Featuring a sturdy steel frame and a maximum load capacity of 120 kg, the iScooter EB5 is suitable for a wide range of everyday riding needs. From commuting and errands to weekend countryside rides, this 20-inch fat tire electric bike combines practical performance with all-terrain versatility.

products.title: iScooter W12 3000W Off Road Electric Scooter
products.body_html:
iScooter W12 3000W Dual Motor Off-Road Electric Scooter

The iScooter W12 is a high-performance dual motor off-road electric scooter built for riders who want serious power, long-range capability and all-terrain performance. With dual 1500W motors delivering up to 3000W peak power, it provides strong acceleration and climbing performance for demanding rides.

Powered by a 52V 25Ah battery with 1300Wh capacity, the W12 offers up to 100 km of range under ideal conditions. Its advanced dual-drive system can be switched between different riding modes, allowing you to balance power, speed and range depending on the terrain and riding conditions.

Built for off-road adventures, the W12 features large 11-inch tubeless off-road tyres and dual swing-arm suspension to improve stability and comfort across gravel, dirt trails, grass and uneven roads. The front and rear disc brakes with power cut-off provide responsive braking control, while the 40% maximum gradeability gives the scooter the capability to tackle steep inclines.

The W12 also features a 4.5-inch colour display, bright LED lighting, turn signals, rear brake lights and RGB ambient lighting for improved visibility and a distinctive riding experience. With Voltix App connectivity, riders can manage smart locking, cruise control and single- or dual-drive modes directly from their smartphone.

Despite its powerful performance, the W12 folds for easier storage and transportation. With a 150 kg maximum payload and a wide deck, it is designed to provide a stable and comfortable platform for longer rides.

Whether you're exploring off-road trails, tackling steep hills or looking for a powerful all-terrain electric scooter, the iScooter W12 combines dual motor performance, long-range battery capacity and advanced suspension in one high-performance machine.

K6 Kids Electric Scooter with Dual Suspension
products.body_html:
Why parents choose the K6

Make every ride more comfortable with the iScooter K6 kids electric scooter. Designed for children aged 6–12 (120–160 cm), this foldable 7 kg scooter combines front and rear swingarm suspension, 3 handlebar heights and 3 speed modes for everyday outdoor adventures.

A birthday or holiday gift that grows with your child — handlebar heights of 88 / 94.5 / 102 cm, speeds of 5 / 10 / 16 km/h, and a compact foldable frame. The K6 is our kids’ scooter with dual swingarm suspension, for a smoother ride on everyday pavements.

A helmet and protective pads are not included — we recommend wearing them on every ride, with adult supervision. Magnetic charging is safer and easier for kids to plug in. Most families have it ready to ride in about 10 minutes; a hex wrench and the user manual are in the box.

Please ride on pavements, in parks or in the neighbourhood, and follow local rules. The K6 is IP54 splash-proof and is not intended for heavy rain or off-road use. Range is typically 7–9 km, up to a maximum of 9 km, on a 21.6V 2.6Ah battery. After-sales support is covered by a 12-month warranty.

Dual Swingarm Suspension for a Smoother Ride

The K6 features front and rear swingarm suspension to help absorb bumps and vibrations from uneven pavements. Combined with 6.5-inch solid tyres, it delivers a more comfortable riding experience for young riders.

Foldable Design for Easy Storage

The practical folding design and 7 kg net weight make the K6 easy to store at home, carry in the car or take along on family trips.

3 Speed Modes for Different Riding Levels

Powered by a 150W motor, the K6 offers three speed settings: E 5 km/h, D 10 km/h and S 16 km/h. Beginners can start at a lower speed and progress as their confidence develops, with adult supervision and a helmet.

Fun Lighting and Bluetooth Connectivity

Colourful lighting adds a playful touch to every ride, while Bluetooth connectivity lets children enjoy music through a compatible device. The digital display makes it easy to check essential riding information.
